invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Pair, never null.
The first element of the returned Pair is partitionPathStatMap, which is always a non-null Map.
The second element of the returned Pair is globalStat, which is always a WorkloadStat object and not null.
There can be at most one partitionPathStatMap entry per partitionPath present in inputRecords.
A Map cannot have negative size.
